value.author: Alexdurana
value.title: El hotel en el que debes alojarte si vas a Sitges :-)
value.text:
Tanto las instalaciones como el personal son excelentes. Casa Mett es, sin duda, la mejor opción que existe ahora mismo para alojarse en Sitges.
— Nada, la experiencia fue increíble.

value.author: Pascal
value.title: New hotel. Very nice rooms. Great pool. Very good staff!
value.text:
Very good staff. The pool and services. Breakfast.
— Hôtel just reopened. Little things like wardrobe in rooms have to be improved. Comment taken into account.

value.author: Francisco
value.title: Exceptional
value.text: Os quartos são muitos bons e a atenção prestada ao cliente foi soberba. Espaço muito bonito.

value.author: Julia
value.title: Pleasant
value.text:
La piscina
— Las habitaciones muy pequeñas ,
La televisión no funcionaba, el wifi tampoco etc

value.author: Daniel
value.title: Minor Hiccups but worth it
value.text:
Amazing pool area. The pool area gets the sun all day. 
the staff were fantastic and friendly. 
there was at one point in my stay more staff around the pool than guests. 
very chilled atmosphere - I'd absolutely stay here agin for 2-3 nights.
— As its a brand new hotel there were some hiccups upon check-in that were resolved quickly and involved me moving to another room. 
There are a couple of new hotel things : its hard to open the windows with how the curtains are hung and the rooms are one of the smallest I've stayed in a 5 star. 
The service needs work, you can be staring at a waiter at the pool for 5 minutes or wave and in the end its just better to go to the bar and order. The air con  takes a little while to cool down the room. I ran out of hot water one night. 
Could do with an iron or a steamer already in the room.

value.author: Janina
value.title: It was my honeymoon. It was very romantic
value.text:
The Location was breath taking.
— Parts of the pool was hard to navigate. To many potted plants. Had to pay for Breakfast.

value.author: Lorraine
value.title: Excellent.
value.text:
Brand new.  Stunning. Amazing staff.  Super pool area. Lovely food.  Right on the beach. 10 mins walk from everything.
— A few little bits need attention. It’s new build.

value.author: Joan
value.title: Preciós
value.text: Ho tenen tot molt ben arreglat i molt maco, amb un tracte del personal molt agradable. Molt recomenable.
